0022600182.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-3) visit the Denver Nuggets (3-3) in the Raptors' eighth game of the season. Toronto is on a one-game winning streak, 2-2 on the road, and sits 3rd in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back and 4th in the East, while Denver is 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back and 10th in the West. Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out for Toronto, Jakob Poeltl is day-to-day with shoulder inflammation and a game-time decision, Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are out for Denver, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The Raptors lost their last meeting 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026, and lost 0-2 in the 2025-26 season series.
